name: lh5801-asm
description: Syntax highlighting for the sdaslh5801 (PC-1500 LH5801) assembler dialect, matching pc1500emu's disassembler output and https://github.com/pchambre/sdcc-pc1500

lh5801.disasmCommand.description: Path to your built pc1500disasm executable, used by 'LH5801: Disassemble to ASM'. Supports ${workspaceFolder}. E.g. ${workspaceFolder}/build/src/disasm/RelWithDebInfo/pc1500disasm.exe on Windows, or ${workspaceFolder}/build/src/disasm/pc1500disasm on Linux/Mac.

lh5801.sdasCommand.description: Command to run sdaslh5801, used by 'LH5801: Assemble to BIN'. A single string split on spaces (no quoting support -- keep paths space-free, or point at a wrapper script). Windows: a plain native-exe path, e.g. 'C:/path/to/sdcc/bin_vc/sdaslh5801.exe' (an MSVC or MSYS2 build), or 'wsl /mnt/c/path/to/sdcc/bin/sdaslh5801' for a WSL-only build (a Windows-style absolute path -- C:\... -- given as a later argument is auto-translated to /mnt/c/... for the wsl case, since WSL itself does not reliably do this). Linux/Mac: a plain path, e.g. '/home/you/sdcc/bin/sdaslh5801' -- no prefix needed.

lh5801.linkCommand.description: Command to run sdld (the sdas-family linker), used by 'LH5801: Assemble to BIN' to turn sdaslh5801's .rel output into a flat binary. Same convention as lh5801.sdasCommand -- normally lives right next to it (sdcc/bin/sdld or sdcc/bin_vc/sdld.exe).

lh5801.makebinCommand.description: Command to run makebin, used by 'LH5801: Assemble to BIN' and 'LH5801: Build C to BIN' to turn a linked .ihx into a flat .bin. Same convention as lh5801.sdasCommand -- normally lives right next to it (sdcc/bin/makebin or sdcc/bin_vc/makebin.exe).

lh5801.buildCCommand.description: Command to run build-lh5801.sh (sdcc-pc1500's support/scripts/build-lh5801.sh), used by 'LH5801: Build C to BIN'. This is a bash script: on Windows it always needs the 'wsl ...' form (e.g. 'wsl /mnt/c/path/to/sdcc-pc1500/sdcc/support/scripts/build-lh5801.sh' -- there's no native sdcc.exe build, so this is WSL-only regardless of whether sdasCommand/linkCommand/makebinCommand above are native); on Linux/Mac, a plain path (e.g. '/home/you/sdcc-pc1500/sdcc/support/scripts/build-lh5801.sh', already executable) or 'bash <path>' works directly, no prefix.

lh5801.emulatorPath.description: Path to pc1500emu(.exe), used by 'LH5801: Run in pc1500emu' and 'LH5801: Debug in pc1500emu' to launch a fresh instance when one isn't already running. Supports ${workspaceFolder}. Default is this repo's own Windows (Visual Studio generator) build output; on Linux, use ${workspaceFolder}/build/src/host/pc1500emu (no RelWithDebInfo path segment, no .exe).

lh5801.romPath.description: Path to ROM1.BIN, passed to a freshly-launched pc1500emu by 'LH5801: Run in pc1500emu' / 'LH5801: Debug in pc1500emu'. Not needed if you always attach to an already-running instance.

lh5801.extRam4800Bytes.description: Extension RAM (bytes) at 4800H-6FFFH -- the CE-158-style expansion module -- for a *freshly-launched* pc1500emu started by 'LH5801: Run in pc1500emu' / 'LH5801: Debug in pc1500emu' (never applied when attaching to one already running). 0 = none (base 2KB only, matches every default before this setting existed). Non-zero forces that launch to boot cold (--no-state), since the size is only detected by the ROM on a fresh, non-restored boot -- see AppConfig::extRam4800Bytes in src/hoststate/app_config.h.

lh5801.extRam0000Bytes.description: Extension RAM (bytes) at 0000H-3FFFH -- an emulator-only option with no real 1982 hardware equivalent -- for a freshly-launched pc1500emu. Same cold-boot caveat as lh5801.extRam4800Bytes.

slot.description: Which of the 4 independent ROM module slots (0-3, matching 'LH5801: Run in pc1500emu''s own Extension ROM Slot 1-4 picker).

requirePv.description: Module requires the PV flag (CE-158-family modules).

usePuBank.description: Module is PU-banked (file must be even-sized).

path.description: Path to the ROM module file. Supports ${workspaceFolder}.

lh5801.preloadRomModules.description: Auxiliary ROM modules (e.g. a CE-150/158) to load into a *freshly-launched* pc1500emu, before the main program itself, for 'LH5801: Run in pc1500emu' / 'LH5801: Debug in pc1500emu' (never applied when attaching to one already running). An entry whose slot collides with the main program's own chosen slot (when it's loaded as a ROM module itself) is skipped with a warning.

program.description: Path to the assembled binary or ROM module to load.

loadAddress.description: Hex address (no 0x prefix) to load `program` at.

loadMode.description: "binary" writes program's bytes directly into memory (loadbinary); "rommodule" maps it as a CE-150/153/158-style plug-in ROM module (loadrommodule).

requirePv.description: rommodule mode only: module requires the PV flag.

usePuBank.description: rommodule mode only: module is PU-banked (must be an even-sized file).

entry.description: Hex address (no 0x prefix) to set P to before running. Defaults to loadAddress.

listing.description: Path to the sdaslh5801 -l listing (.lst) file, for source-line breakpoints and stepping. Omit to debug at the instruction level only.

sourcePath.description: Path to the .asm source shown for stack frames. Defaults to the listing path.

stopOnEntry.description: Stop at the entry point before running.

emulatorPath.description: Path to pc1500emu.exe. If given, the adapter launches it (and closes it on disconnect). If omitted, the adapter attaches to an already-running instance's command pipe instead.

romPath.description: Path to ROM1.BIN. Required if emulatorPath is given, unless emulatorArgs is given instead.

emulatorArgs.description: Extra CLI args for a freshly-launched emulatorPath, overriding the bare romPath positional arg when given -- usually auto-populated by 'LH5801: Debug in pc1500emu' itself (e.g. ["--conf", "<generated path>", "--no-state"] when lh5801.extRam4800Bytes/extRam0000Bytes are non-default), not meant to be hand-written.

preloadRomModules.description: Auxiliary ROM modules to load (via loadrommodule) right after a freshly-launched emulatorPath comes up, before `program` itself -- same shape as, and usually auto-populated from, lh5801.preloadRomModules. Only takes effect when emulatorPath is given (a fresh launch); ignored when attaching to an already-running instance.
